text:
Priya Nair: Quick quarterly milelog check — short async thread for shipped/slipped/next steps. TL;DR: Search-indexing feature and embed-cache rollout shipped to prod; model-routing work slipped ~2w; need CRs for routing heuristics and infra ownership for canary. See asks below.

Alex Chen: Thanks. Can you call out who owns final rollback/runbook?

Priya Nair: @Alex Chen owns rollback/runbook for indexing. @Jordan Lee owns model-routing patch & canary plan. @Samir Patel will handle Dedicated capacity bump if canary needs extra headroom.

Jordan Lee: Confirming — model-routing slipped because of a perf regression on 8k contexts. I have a repro, working on a fix. Plan: patch + e2e perf test, then small canary (10% traffic) for 48h. Need CR reviews from Maya and Alex.

Maya Ortiz: I can review CRs today afternoon. Heads-up: one of my comments will be on KV cache invalidation semantics — small change but worth a quick perf run.

Alex Chen: CR pinged. I'll do a pass after standup. Also tagging @Liza for deploy pipeline check.

Liza (deploy-bot): deploy pipeline status: nightly pipeline green, canary slots available in us-west-2: 2, us-east-1: 1. No blocking incidents.

Samir Patel: I can schedule Reserved capacity bump for a 48h window once canary start time is confirmed. FYI Dedicated billing opt-in required from finance — I'll submit the request today.

Priya Nair: Itemized shipped/sipped:
- Shipped: search-indexing v1.3 (rolled to 100% yesterday) — owner: Alex. Metrics: p99 gen latency down 8%, token-cost ~-3%.
- Shipped: embed-cache for session-scoped embeddings (opt-in) — owner: Maya. Improved repeated request tail.
- Slipped: model-routing heuristics + fallback (was planned end of quarter) — owner: Jordan. Blockers: perf regressions + CR backlog.

Jordan Lee: Repro steps (short):
```
# repro script (local)
python tools/repro_perf.py --model redwood-7b --seq 8192 --batch 1
```
Observed: KV cache churn causing extra mem copies at step ~512. Reducing patch reduces regression but impacts routing accuracy. Need to balance.

Maya Ortiz: Suggestion: run the patch behind a feature flag so can validate accuracy vs perf in parallel.

Jordan Lee: Agree. I'll add a flag + metrics hook (routing_accuracy, kv_copy_rate). Will post a canary plan with exact dates by EOD.

Alex Chen: On code review queue: two PRs for routing heuristics (PR#4920, PR#4921). PR#4920 has unit tests; PR#4921 has perf benchmark script. Prioritize PR#4921 for perf reasons.

Priya Nair: Next steps and owners:
- Jordan: add feature flag + metrics hook, post canary schedule (EOD).
- Alex: complete rollback/runbook + merge PR#4921 (tomorrow AM).
- Maya: final CR review + KV invalidation perf run (tomorrow).
- Samir: submit Dedicated bump request, stand by for canary window.
- Priya: I'll escalate timeline to eng leadership if we can't land canary by next Tue.

Jordan Lee: One ask: need a quick hand from infra to validate kernel pinning on canary nodes. @Samir can you route?

Samir Patel: Yep — I'll ping infra and add kernel/pinning checklist to the canary plan.

Maya Ortiz: Also flagging a related dependency: telemetry team needs a new metric export. @Priya, should I loop them or add to Jordan's canary plan?

Priya Nair: Loop them now — better to get telemetry in place before canary. Jordan, please add required metric names in the canary doc.

Jordan Lee: Will do. Adding metric names: routing_accuracy, kv_copy_rate, latency_p95, failure_rate.

Alex Chen: Any customer-facing impact? Support/customer-success?

Priya Nair: Support FYI: no customer-facing incidents yet. We'll prepare a short note if canary causes any degradation. I'll draft the note.

Maya Ortiz: Quick code-review checklist for reviewers:
- Focus on perf-sensitive changes first.
- Confirm feature flag ensures neutral default.
- Verify metrics hooks are exported correctly.

Priya Nair: Final ask to owners: please update the milestone tracker row with current status + expected canary start time by EOD. Link to tracker: https://redwood-inf.atlassian.net/browse/RI-1234 (internal).

Alex Chen: Updated the tracker. PR#4921 is ready for QA merge after Maya's review.

Jordan Lee: Canary plan posted: start Tue 09:00 PT, 10% traffic, 48h, infra checklist attached. I'll ping again when it's live.

Samir Patel: Dedicated bump request filed (ticket #DB-77). Finance looped.

Priya Nair: Great — thanks everyone. If anything blocks the canary timeline, call it out here. Otherwise we'll reconvene async after canary completes for postmortem/ship decision. :thumbsup:

Alex Chen: Noted.

Maya Ortiz: 👍 will review CRs tonight.

Jordan Lee: Thanks team.
